newsitem.title: ITALY: Stet board could change after sale - Rossi.
newsitem.headline: Stet board could change after sale - Rossi.

text.p: The new board of Italian state telecommunications holding Stet, nominated on Tuesday for a three-year mandate, could see changes following the group's privatisation, chairman Guido Rossi said.
Addressing his first shareholders' meeting, Rossi said: "When this result (privatisation) is achieved I will step down."
The Italian Treasury proposed 14 members of the new board which were duly elected at the meeting.
The Treasury is the majority shareholder in Stet which it wants to merge with telephone operator Telecom Italia by June at the latest before flotation of the new entity in autumn of this year.

Rossi said Stet and Treasury officials were putting together "a very tight calendar" for the privatisation. "This board has a specific mandate to carry out the privatisation and this will be respected," he said.
But he added, "Stet's privatisation must be accompanied by the liberalisation of the whole telecommunications system."
